title: Acceptance sampling from a lot of 40
intro: A receiving inspector takes n = 8 parts, without replacement, from a lot of N = 40, and accepts the lot only if none of the eight is defective. The lot has K = 4 defective parts. X, the number of defectives in the sample, is hypergeometric. The value of interest is k = 0: P(X = 0) = 0.3935 is the chance the lot is accepted. The mean nK/N = 0.8 defectives per sample.
